title: The normalized translated Schur gaps exceed 1/(16 p^2) (no new κ)
body:
## Summary
- At `p=19`, `beta0=-1/2`, bandwidth 2, and `t_i=i`, divide each Schur row on survivors `0,1,2,7,8,9` by its diagonal. Every row gap, one minus the off-diagonal row sum, is strictly greater than `1/(16 p^2)=1/5776`.
- Each normalized off-sum lies strictly below a rational lower bound for `exp(-9 pi/722)+5 exp(-18 pi)`, and that lower bound is strictly below `1-1/5776`. Vertices 0 and 9 use the original exponent majorant. Vertices 1, 2, 7, and 8 use the enclosed off-sums divided by their diagonal lower bounds.
- No new kappa is claimed. The selected record is unchanged. This is one normalized Schur section, not a proof of the note's all-size row gap.
